table_edits.before: Completed DC operating-point records. Voltages and input power are logged values; output power and error are calculated. The original VBUS pp field is retained without correction. All rows use the logged 240 V, 50 Hz input condition. Source: \texttt{Load Data} in \sourcefile{Thesis_USB_PDO_3A_Limited_Test_Plan.xlsx}.
table_edits.after: DC operating-point measurements at 240 V, 50 Hz, with calculated output power and voltage error. VBUS pp keeps the original workbook label. Source: \texttt{Load Data} in \sourcefile{Thesis_USB_PDO_3A_Limited_Test_Plan.xlsx}.

table_edits.before: Screening calculations from eleven eligible row-level records. Source rows refer to the original \texttt{Load Data} sheet. Results are rounded to the precision justified for comparison.
table_edits.after: Initial efficiency estimates from eleven measurements. Row numbers refer to the original \texttt{Load Data} sheet.

table_edits.before: Input-current harmonic percentages transcribed and visually checked against the three retained ITECH current tables. Order 1 is the reference fundamental. The 4.7 A point is an AC-coupled output capture.
table_edits.after: Input-current harmonics from the three ITECH tables. Order 1 is the fundamental. The 4.7 A entry uses an AC-coupled output capture.

table_edits.before: Logged power-quality results. PF and current THD may originate from different instruments or averaging intervals. The associated 3.9 A record is retained for provenance but excluded from trend interpretation.
table_edits.after: Power factor and current THD from the instrument readings. The instruments or averaging intervals can differ. The 3.9 A entry is an associated record and is not used for the load trend.

table_edits.before: Original waveform exports included with the rewritten results. Files are copied without changing samples; SHA-256 digests and complete acquisition metadata appear in \sourcefile{raw_waveform_index.csv}.
table_edits.after: Waveform files, sample counts, and intervals. SHA-256 checksums and acquisition details are listed in \sourcefile{raw_waveform_index.csv}.

table_edits.before: Status, firmware attribution and efficiency-selection rule for every completed workbook record. A missing firmware entry is not assigned to the final release. AC-statistic rows are excluded from DC power calculation.
table_edits.after: Test status, firmware version, and use in the calculations. A dash means the firmware was not recorded. AC-coupled statistics are not used to calculate DC power.

table_edits.before: Readings from all ten labeled thermal screenshots at emissivity 0.95. The lower reference marker is not a documented ambient-temperature measurement.
table_edits.after: Temperature readings from ten thermal images, using emissivity 0.95. The lower reference marker was not confirmed as ambient temperature.

table_edits.before: Recorded numerical fields for completed transient rows. Acquisition-wide pp and averages are not the overshoot relative to the pre-step output; recovery time is unavailable. The 5 V and 20 V removal screenshots have no numerical worksheet row.
table_edits.after: Load-removal measurements from the workbook. Averages and pp span the whole capture and do not give the voltage rise from the pre-step level. Recovery time is not available. The 5 V and 20 V screenshots have no numerical worksheet row.
